Job Summary

  • Designs and implements robust technical solutions that enable critical business operations and enhance customer experience. Ensures system reliability, security, and performance standards are met while driving innovation and operational efficiency. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures that support the bank's digital transformation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.

Skills And Experience

  • Java
  • Spring/SpringBoot
  • Restful API
  • Docker/K8s
  • Postgre/DB2/Oracle
  • Maven/Gradle
  • DevOps/ADO

Motivations

  • Environment: Collaborative, matrix environments where building relationships across functions is essential for success Dynamic settings with competing priorities that require strong organizational and time management skills Inclusive team cultures that value diverse perspectives and encourage open dialogue
  • Outcomes: Delivering high-quality solutions that directly impact business objectives and client satisfaction Contributing to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and reduce operational risk Building sustainable systems and practices that create long-term organizational value]
  • Challenges: Complex problem-solving that requires both analytical thinking and creative approaches Stakeholder management situations requiring influence without direct authority Technical challenges that push the boundaries of current capabilities and require continuous learning
  • Growth: Opportunities to develop both technical depth and business breadth Mentoring and knowledge-sharing that contributes to team capability building Exposure to emerging technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

  • We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
  • Minimum experience of 5 years in Java application development.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 31 October 2026

Job Description

Title Assistant Manager / Manager - Global Tax CoE

Department Global Tax CoE

Location Dalian, China

Reports To Senior Manager - Global Tax CoE

Level 5

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our Business Finance team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

About The CFO Group

The CFO Group is a global corporate function at Fidelity International, operating across all 27 countries and bringing together Finance, Business Consulting, Procurement, Treasury and Corporate Property Services.

The CFO Group exists to actively partner with the business, providing financial clarity, constructive challenge and leadership so that decisions are well governed and value is created across the enterprise. Through the Finance Fast Forward programme, the function is evolving towards a more modern, commercially focused and insight‑led model, strengthening its use of data, automation and judgement to support high‑quality decision‑making, robust control and sustainable outcome.

About Your Role

As an Assistant Manager / Manager in the Global Tax CoE team, you will play a key role in supporting FIL entities across Japan and selected jurisdictions, ensuring the effective delivery of tax compliance, tax accounting, tax reporting and tax risk management activities.

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end tax activities, including statutory tax filings, tax reporting, tax accounting and reconciliations, tax audits and enquiries, tax authority interactions and tax technical analysis. The role requires the application of sound professional judgement to ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements and FIL’s internal control framework.

Working within a global operating model, you will collaborate closely with onshore and offshore stakeholders across Finance, Tax and other corporate functions to deliver high-quality outcomes, strengthen tax governance, and support continuous process improvements across multiple jurisdictions.

About You

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure timely and accurate tax filings in compliance with local regulations and internal policies
  • Coordinate with external tax advisors on annual tax compliance activities and other tax- related matters
  • Lead and respond to tax audits, inspections, and inquiries from authorities
  • Perform tax account reconciliations and ensure accurate booking of tax-related nominal accounts
  • Provide timely analysis and resolution of tax issues identified during operations or audits
  • Prepare supporting documentation for tax filings, including schedules, reports, and reconciliations ensuring completeness and accuracy
  • Provide tax advisory and ad hoc support to internal stakeholders on tax-related matters
  • Collaborate closely with the APAC Tax and finance teams, and local stakeholders to support the effective delivery of tax activities
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with tax authorities and support interactions on tax-related matters
  • Drive process improvements, standardization, and automation initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of tax activities

Experience and Qualifications Required:

  • Strong experience in tax or finance roles with exposure to Japan entities, preferably within a multinational or shared services environment
  • Good understanding of Japan tax regulations and compliance requirements
  • Experience supporting tax compliance, tax reporting, and tax audit activities
  • Ability to analyze tax issues and apply practical solutions
  • Strong attention to details and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting tight deadlines
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, locations, and cultures
  • Experience driving process improvements and automation initiatives
  • Proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented mindset
  • Fluent English and Japanese (essential)
  • Professional accounting or tax qualification (e.g., CPA, CTA) is preferred

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

  • Participate in technical review, problem troubleshooting and key project delivery, support the smooth progress of large-scale R&D projects.

  • Solid Java programming foundation, proficient in mainstream development frameworks and system design methodologies.
  • Rich experience in microservice API design, development and maintenance.
  • Familiar with automated testing implementation and related tool chains.
  • Proficient in Jenkins Pipeline for CI/CD construction and Docker containerization deployment.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Supporting tasks to assist in maintaining and strengthening distribution channel relationships, whilst coordinating the relevant business initiatives.
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, enhance insurance sales capabilities, and achieve sustained performance growth.
    • Train core competencies across the full sales process, implementing insurance sales competency development, including execution of phone appointments, in-depth KYC, case solution and closing.
    • Train and coach RM to how complete Policy Review and analyse Policy Review Reports to customers
    • Participate in customer events and training sessions, assist with pre-event preparations, provide on-site support, and conduct post-event evaluations and follow-ups.
  • Support relationship managers in analyzing and diagnosing client needs, designing tailored solutions, and preparing for client meetings. Enhance practical capabilities through role-play and rehearsals focused on solution presentation and deal closing.
  • Provide coaching on sales strategies for INSH proprietary products, building on the foundational training delivered by Business Development Managers. Help relationship managers improve practical product skills, including aligning product features with client needs and integrating relevant service resources.
  • Analyze market trends and competitor products to identify and articulate the core strengths of INSH products. Develop sales strategies aligned with client profiles, incorporating sales logic and applicable scenarios. Continuously refine strategies through case reviews to improve sales effectiveness
  • Deliver one-on-one coaching to help relationship managers translate knowledge into practical skills, assisting RM to complete pre-case/pre-meeting.
  • Supporting the development and execution of channel development plans and strategies, continuously optimizing existing cooperation models.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders, which may include relationship managers and product team, to maximise empowerment for distribution channels.
  • Assisting in execution of compliance review processes and due diligence to ensure all operations adhere to risk control requirement.
  • 协助建立并维护与分支行及相关业务部门的良好合作关系，确保合作顺畅及内部服务体验。
  • 负责提供一对一教练式的陪跑辅导，实现知识向技能转化，提升保险销售能力，以实现绩效持续稳定的增长。
    • 训练全销售流程的核心技能，实施保险销售能力养成，包含电话约访、深度KYC、解决方案呈现及成交等。
    • 培训并指导客户经理如何完成保单检视，并指导如何为客户分析保单检视报告。
    • 参与行所沙龙及内部培训等活动，配合做好活动前相关准备工作，提供现场赋能支持，并做好活动后的评估及。活动效果的跟进。
  • 协助客户经理完成客户需求分析与诊断，设计解决方案；并做好相应面谈准备，通过演练、预演递交解决方案及成交过程，提升客户经理的实战作业能力。
  • 负责产品强化训练辅导，针对INSH自有产品在由业务发展经理完成的销售资质培训基础上开展产品销售策略的训练辅导，帮助客户经理提升产品相关的实战能力，包含产品功能与客户需求的匹配分析，以及与产品功能相关的服务资源整合。
  • 负责市场及同业产品对比分析，通过分析提炼INSH产品核心优势，结合销售逻辑及应用场景，整理与客户概貌相匹配的产品销售策略，并通过典型案例复盘持续优化策略，提升销售有效性。
  • 支持制定并执行新业务拓展计划与策略，持续优化现有合作模式。
  • 与产品部门、客户经理及相关团队保持紧密协作，最大化赋能合作渠道。
  • 严格协助执行相关客户尽职调查及合规审查工作，做好风险控制。
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Reasonable experience in sales force (5 years )
  • Possess board-based knowledge of the Insurance business and China practices
  • Good influential skills – able to influence people of different cultures and backgrounds
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese. Must be able to communicate effectively in Putonghua.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills – excellent customer relationship management
  • Able to lead, inspire, motivate and develop the teams to deliver business performance and a team player.
  • 具备5年以上销售或业务相关工作经验，有银行渠道或金融机构合作经验者优先
  • 熟悉保险业务及金融产品，了解国内银行渠道业务模式及监管要求
  • 具备良好的沟通协调能力及影响力，能够与不同层级的银行人员建立有效合作
  • 中英文口头与书面沟通能力优秀，必须能流利使用普通话进行商务沟通
  • 具备较强的客户服务意识及关系维护能力，能妥善处理渠道合作中的各项事务
  • 具备团队协作精神，能配合内部团队共同推动业务发展，达成整体目标

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Strategy & Setup:

  • Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
  • Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
  • Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:

  • Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
  • Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
  • Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
  • Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.

Core Operations Management:

  • Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
  • Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
  • Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management:

  • Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.

Financial & Performance Management:

  • Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
  • Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
  • Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
    • Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
    • Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge & Skills:
    • In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
    • Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
    • Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
    • Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Education & Language:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
    • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
    • Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

  • Where I have not received dispensation, I have received approval from the QPR Coordinator to submit this initiative into the proposed backlog for approval"

  • Collaborate with Security Champions to identify and implement the necessary security controls tailored to the specific delivery or process.Identify Applicable Security controls by engaging with Security Champs

Business

Processes

People & Talent

  • Contribute to technical innovation and share knowledge within the engineering community.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, lead internal workshops and seminars, encourage team participation in innovation initiatives

Governance

  • Comply with System Delivery controls and attest for it with every (technical) release to production
  • The controls cover: Requirements, Architecture (see Architecture Review Forum below), Security (see Cyber Security Services below), Development, Testing, IT Resilience, Service Level Management, Tech Operations & Support, Release Management, SW Configuration Management

  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

  • Agile/Scrum

Job Summary

About the Role

Own and continuously improve mobile customer journeys that drive digital sales, engagement, and customer satisfaction across Standard Chartered's key markets. You will be accountable for the performance of your journeys, measured through conversion, activation, engagement, and customer satisfaction metrics.

This is an AI-first product owner role. AI is expected to be embedded into every stage of product management from customer discovery and research to prioritisation, experimentation, delivery, analytics, and optimisation. Product Owners are assessed not only on delivery outcomes, but also on their ability to leverage AI, data, and experimentation to accelerate customer and business outcomes

Description

  • Partner with design and challenge it with evidence: journey maps, drop-off analysis, usability findings and benchmarks against regional and global banking apps.
  • Run your own research: usability tests, funnel diagnostics, protect end-to-end journey coherence, including handoffs to RM and assisted channels. Translate business OKRs into a prioritised squad backlog and quarterly roadmap. Make trade-offs explicit and defend them with data.
  • Ship features that move digital sales conversion, funnel completion, active usage and CSAT/NPS. You are measured on these numbers, not on velocity alone.
  • Manage delivery with engineering: shape the tech backlog with your lead engineer, sequence dependencies, and take releases through governance across markets.
  • Use AI across the full PO lifecycle: discovery synthesis, user stories and acceptance criteria, competitive research, prototyping, funnel analysis and reporting.
  • Own the GenAI agenda for your surface: identify where AI belongs in the product (assistance, personalisation, content intelligence) and build the case with data.
  • Ground every prioritisation decision in observed customer behaviour.
  • Form testable hypotheses for mobile experience: define the metric, the expected movement and the mechanism before anything gets built.
  • Keep a hypothesis backlog alongside the feature backlog. Experiment velocity is a tracked metric.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities:

Customer Journey Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end performance of mobile customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, servicing, wealth, and engagement experiences.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience, conversion rates, engagement, and satisfaction.
  • Protect journey integrity across digital, RM-assisted, contact centre, and branch touchpoints.
  • Ensure customer needs and behavioral insights drive prioritization decisions.

Data-Driven Product Discovery

  • Conduct customer research using usability testing, behavioral analytics, VOC analysis, session replay, funnel diagnostics, and market benchmarking.
  • Analyze customer drop-offs, friction points, and conversion barriers within mobile journeys.
  • Benchmark against leading regional and global banking, fintech, e-commerce, and digital-native experiences.
  • Translate customer insights into product opportunities and measurable outcomes.

Experimentation & Growth

  • Develop and maintain a hypothesis backlog alongside the feature backlog.
  • Define measurable hypotheses before development begins, including:
  • Target customer behavior
  • Success metrics
  • Expected impact
  • Validation criteria
  • Partner with UX and analytics teams to design and execute experiments.
  • Manage A/B testing and personalization programmes to improve journey performance.
  • Drive continuous optimization of customer acquisition, activation, and engagement funnels.

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Translate business OKRs into prioritised roadmaps and delivery plans.
  • Make data-driven trade-offs between customer value, business impact, technical complexity, and delivery timelines.
  • Prioritise initiatives that maximise customer and commercial outcomes.
  • Own quarterly planning and backlog prioritisation for your squads.

AI-Enabled Product Management

  • Leverage AI throughout the product lifecycle, including:
  • Discovery synthesis
  • Competitive analysis
  • User story creation
  • Acceptance criteria generation
  • Customer insight extraction
  • Analytics interpretation
  • Reporting and communication
  • Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into customer journeys, including:
  • Conversational assistance
  • Personalisation
  • Content generation
  • Intelligent guidance
  • Product recommendations
  • Build business cases for GenAI-driven experiences supported by customer and performance data.

Delivery Leadership

  • Partner with Engineering Leads to shape technical backlogs and delivery plans.
  • Manage dependencies across platforms, markets, and teams.
  • Drive delivery through governance, compliance, risk, and release processes.
  • Monitor post-launch performance and ensure benefits realisation.

  • Funnel analysis
  • Segmentation

  • Calculated metrics
  • Attribution analysis

  • Strong understanding of:
  • Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
  • Journey analytics
  • Personalisation
  • Experimentation frameworks
  • Statistical significance

AI-First Product Management

  • Proven experience applying Generative AI to product management workflows.
  • Ability to demonstrate real-world AI-assisted delivery practices.

  • PEGA Customer Decision Hub
  • Mobile app ecosystems (iOS / Android)
  • API-driven architectures

  • Revenue contribution from owned journeys

Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team

Transactional FX is a high-profile joint venture between the Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB). Transactional FX team is responsible for delivering one of the fastest growing revenue streams in CB & IB by providing market leading FX workflow solutions to clients. Transactional FX leverages the firm’s position as a market leader in CB and offers variety of standard and bespoke FX solutions to solve for client’s FX workflow needs.

What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
  • 20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
  • A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
  • On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
  • Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members


Your Key Responsibilities

The role focuses on the end-to-end implementation process of TFX solutions on both the CB and the IB side of the setup. The implementation/project manager has full responsibility for the end-to-end execution of FX4Cash implementation deals for CB clients. The deals may include customized client business requirements, testing coordination, training/coaching (internally and externally) and the setup of highly technical products in multiple phases. In addition, support might need to be provided to other implementation responsibilities, e.g., client migration projects.

In addition to this, role requires candidate to be able to understand business economics and drive commercial initiatives, track business performance, run analytical models to find opportunities, perform product management & risk control activities.

The TFX Specialist role Relationship and Transaction Management (RTM) includes the following

  • Manages implementation pipelines and progress efficiently and effectively. At the same time, communicates and conducts regular status reviews/meetings and ensures that the implementation meets the agreed milestones and client’s expectation.
  • Manages migration projects incl communication with stakeholders.
  • Establish, develop and cultivate relationships between the various stakeholders (implementations, support groups, sales, PSS)
  • Identifies and manages/resolves potential issues and risks.
  • Ability to effectively interface with people at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Responsible that all task deliverables are met in a timely fashion.
  • Create and manage project plans for high value deals
  • Produce management reporting and performance tracking, business KPI’s
  • Ability to manage more than one project and multiple delivery dates at a time.
  • Become the Center of Competence for Transactional FX.
  • Give assistance and support on any question/queries on Implementation process.
  • Work effectively in a matrix environment in a global organization.
  • Comply with all DB policies and procedures


Your Skills And Experience

  • Analytical and process driven with structured work ethics
  • Ability to understand complex technology structures to be able to understand various systems and set ups involved. Experience in FIX API and REST API implementation is a plus.
  • Excellent office skills to include experience with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Good conceptual grasp of FX payments, pricing and market terminology
  • Knowledge of Corporate cash management and general correspondence banking
  • Knowledge and experience in analytical tools like Tableau would be added advantage
  • Experience in Implementation or operations would be added advantage
  • Strong customer orientation and service vision with sense of urgency
  • Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment, prioritizes multiple tasks, and meets strict deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication skills and problem-solving skills
  • Experience of working in KPI-driven, performance-metric focused, timeliness and quality focused environment
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs


How We’ll Support You

  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • Training and development to help you excel in your career


About Us And Our Teams

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank & Diversity

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

ln:4471465407.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of VP - CRM.

Principal responsibilities

  • The role is responsible for the management of all customer information and provision of analytical and data science deliverables for customer and banking initiatives and to support AMH activities. The individual is also expected to identify key trends that arise from the insights of customer data and work with other areas in AMH to ensure they are taken account of.
  • The suitable candidate should be a self-driven person and a leader by nature in taking full ownership of the deliverables. One should be technically profound and fully loaded with business acumen and communication skills. One will work hands-on with the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Jupyter environment for data and modeling process, and are required to deliver the results in a logical and ethical way to the stakeholders.
  • Design, formulate, and implement relevant solutions for the identified analytics project and convert analytical findings/solutions that will lead to achieving business goals (revenue growth, anti-attrition, and increasing customer engagement, etc.). During the process, closely collaborate with relevant teams/parties to obtain the supports required for these tasks. Elevate CRM capabilities to tailor make messaging strategies and journeys that best meet GC customer needs and deliver business outcomes.
  • Use company provided software tools to extract, collect, manipulate (e.g. subset and merge) raw data to prepare for further analysis. Then apply the appropriate analytics frameworks, statistic procedures or machine learning algorithms to analyze the data in order to provide actionable analysis findings. Interpret and present quantitative information as well as the findings in proper context so as to help in the investigations and decision making of the business.
  • To design and develop robust, relevant data mining solutions – descriptive or predictive, the incumbent should flexibly and innovatively apply diverse modelling methods including (but not limited to): decision tree, clustering, logistic regression, gradient boosting, neural network, random forest, support vector machine etc. Mobilise and optimize CRM resources to support the development and ongoing monitoring of GC contact strategies based on customers’ needs (right message at the right time through the right channel), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and HSBC standards, with the ambition to lead the market.
  • Drive the improvement of cross border communications via feedback to the GC governance team to maximise customer contact for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage the timely delivery of output and effectively communicate with all stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor (minimum with 6+ year experience) or Master degree in relevant quantitative disciplines such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Physics or a related discipline with a focus on use of analytics and optimization to influence business decisions.
  • Excellent hands-on analytical skills with proven ability to analyse complex data, identify key trends and opportunities, putting forward hypotheses and delivering recommendations.
  • Mature and independent professional to drive analytics workstream with minimal oversight
  • Train non-analyst stakeholders, teams and audiences to better use our digital analytics suite of tools.
  • Able to work independently with guidance from remote teams.
  • Excellent communication skills. Be able to understand the background of the audience and be able to communicate the message in an effective manner.
  • Proven knowledge and experience of SQL, Python and other Database/Data Manipulation tools (eg max-compute, BI).
  • Experience in data visualization tools and techniques – previous experience in Qliksense, Tableau or similar.
  • Good experience and knowledge of one of analytics tools – Python/R/SAS/SPSS/STATA.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.


Our teams of experts in close to 30 countries advise clients on their strategic development, helping them to grow and transform their businesses, and maximize their positive impact. Natixis CIB is committed to aligning its financing portfolio with a carbon neutrality path by 2050 while helping its clients reduce the environmental impact of their business.


As part of Groupe BPCE, the second largest banking group in France through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne retail networks, Natixis CIB benefits from the Group’s financial strength and solid financial ratings (Standard & Poor's: A+, Moody's: A2, Fitch: A+, R&I: A+).


Reporting Line


Reports functionally to Head of Financial Control APAC, and locally to Head of Finance China.


Main Responsibilities:


Team Lead – Regional Financial Control

  • Lead the day-to-day activities of the regional financial control, ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient delivery of activities within the team’s scope.
  • Manage workforce allocation, provide guidance and training to team members, maintain operational resilience.
  • Adhere to all accounting controls and governance framework and maintain up-to-date standard operating procedures (SOP) and task lists.
  • Streamline work processes and initiate automation for process efficiency.


Finance Control Responsibilities - NAPL

  • Produce and/or manage the full Financial Control activities for Natixis Australia Pty Ltd (“NAPL”), including accounting close and control, group reporting, management reporting, tax, audit, budget/forecast, and minimal regulatory reporting.
  • LOD1 control/ account substantiation.
  • Coordinate statutory reporting, tax filing and other ad-hoc requirements.


Operational Transfer Pricing (OTP) - Regional

  • Act as the SME for APAC recharge process, ensuring OTP calculations, bookings, reconciliations and supporting documentation are completed accurately and on time.
  • Monitor issues impacting transfer pricing operations and drive timely resolution.
  • Support reviews, audits and documentation requirements related to OTP processes.
  • Coordinate with various stakeholders across APAC.


Accounting Controls and regional support

  • Supervise the daily nostro and suspense reconciliation activities performed by the team
  • Weekly review of nostro and suspense unmatched and ageing report.
  • Review the month end journal entries.
  • Produce or assist in the quarterly group reporting.
  • Support other regional finance activities /ad-hoc projects.


Required Skills:


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related discipline; professional accounting qualification is an advantage.
  • Minimum 7 years of relevant Accounting/Finance experience in banks
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, reconciliations, bank operations and controls.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel with automation capability.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage cross-border relationships effectively.
  • Support migration and transition of Finance activities into the Shanghai.
